H01.description: Containment only resolves a symlinked leaf, so a hook path through an intermediate symlinked directory under .claude/ can register a script outside .claude/ without error.

H02.description: The check only verifies that a floor gate script exists on disk, not that settings.json registers it, so an unregistered floor gate leaves --check green while the gate never runs.

H03.description: render_hooks_ref checks marker counts but not their order, so an end marker placed before the begin marker makes the awk pass drop all content after the begin line from the hooks reference.

H04.description: The depth-1 checkout has no origin/main ref, so the floor-snapshot tests that compare against origin/main skip in CI and the floor proof never runs there.

H05.description: resolve_toggles applies LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES even when not in arm mode and also for the baseline arm, so a stale environment variable silently changes what a non-arm or baseline run measures.

H06.description: When the constraints.json rewrite fails, the karpathy_block toggle passes silently and the result is never checked, so an arm can record the toggle as applied while the Karpathy rows remain.

H07.description: LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT is recorded without checking that it is a hex id or that it matches the prompt tree's HEAD, so trials from different trees can claim the same source_commit and pass the skew check.

H08.description: Header comment updated to describe the new default executor model (comment only).

H09.description: The default model claude-fable-5-1 gives non-homogeneous trials, because a safeguard refusal makes the CLI fall back to Opus mid-session, so the arm measurements mix models.

H10.description: The --batch regex accepts '.' and '..', so BATCH_DIR resolves to the suite directory or its parent instead of a child batch directory.

H11.description: verify_corpus only checks files that are listed in SHA256SUMS, so an unlisted file added to the corpus reaches the sandbox under an unchanged corpus digest and is not reported as drift.

H12.description: The pristine-worktree check ignores git-ignored files, so leftover .loa.config.yaml or .run/ files from earlier runs get copied into every sandbox under one recorded commit.

H13.description: Transport-failure classification greps the agent's own output with loose patterns such as 'network', so the agent under test can trigger a retry just by mentioning such text.

H14.description: The trial launch passes an inherited LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES from the parent environment through to execute-agent.sh, overriding the suite-declared toggles of the arm.

H15.description: The secret-redaction patterns miss common credential shapes (PEM keys, JWTs, fine-grained GitHub, Google and Stripe keys, generic tokens), and the \s in the password/secret patterns can match across lines, so secrets get copied into fixtures unredacted.

H16.description: The scope exclusion does not drop a root CLAUDE.md, so a fixture can carry an instruction file that Claude Code may load for the agent under test (the fix calls this defensive).

H17.description: Test updated to pass the prompt tree's real HEAD as the source commit.

H18.description: Test assertion updated and a regression test added for source-commit validation and toggle handling.

H19.description: Test expectation updated for the new default model id.

H20.description: Floor-snapshot tests rescoped to floor hooks and fence ids, with new tests for the deny list and gate registration.
